title: Astrid and the Postcards
author: Petra Okafor
blurb: Zephyrine Oyelaran, a translator losing a childhood language one borrowed word at a time, has perfected the smile that ends conversations. Then a song on the radio is one that was written and never recorded — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must return to the place where the story went wrong before the last bus to the old neighborhood is rerouted forever.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
